svg.text: Electrical simulation: findings and fixes
A reproducible SPICE experiment for the proposed extension. The existing Phase 3 circuit was not modified or energized.
SIMULATION CANDIDATE - bounded models only; no construction, procurement or physical commissioning release
Result within the declared model envelope
48 required scenarios pass; 6 unsafe comparison cases detected.
Each accepted transient reaches its requested end time.
R/L/diode/switch equations plus behavioral protection ICs.
What the simulation does not establish
No selected-component SOA, thermal or contact certification.
No fluid dynamics, actual pump control electronics or valve motion.
No physical pressure target, wiring sign-off or final priced basket.
Rejected comparison circuits and resulting candidate changes
Insufficient transmitter supply
12 V + 150 ohm cannot maintain the requested 20 mA.
24 V +/-10% instrument loop; 100 ohm burden.
ADC overrange and power-off backfeed
24 mA / 150 ohm exceeds the normal 3.3 V input rail.
Current limit + 10 kohm + clamp + power-off isolation.
Unclamped inductive turn-off
Negative control reaches assumed avalanche at 100.2 V at a drain.
Opposed diode/avalanche clamp on each modeled load.
Automatic restart after E-stop
Deliberately unsafe reset logic is rejected.
Fresh reset edge with permit low; heartbeat and power-good.
Combined master/contact and transistor faults
The combined welded master + shorted MOSFET remains unsafe.
Retain independent E-stop cutoff; no claim of universal fault tolerance.
Negative controls are intentional experiments, not reconstructions of the existing Phase 3 bench.
9 November 2026 | ngspice 47 | All voltages relative to model node 0; Pi header allocation remains unfrozen
